unit_requirement: Two complete already-exposed prose contexts, including every exact group and alternative reading, nominated before new meanings. Exact context/source IDs and prospective meaning bindings are missing; producer reads no manuscript bodies.
inherited_stops: FM/FN and older models remain byte-for-byte unchanged. No arbitrary SHOL gloss, Motion repair, inherited qualities, Latin default, capacity rerun, new decoder or global framework.
title: RAW UNREVIEWED: a reported failed procedure motivates a superseding instruction without erasing the earlier episode
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_UNTESTED. A whole narrative or technical account may record an attempted procedure and an observed failure, diagnose a mismatched condition, then issue a revised instruction. The earlier attempted event remains part of history while its recommendation loses force. This is content-internal correction, distinct from the researcher changing frozen glosses after failure.

design.mechanism: Enter an attempted action with an owned patient; report an outcome that fails an explicit criterion; bind a diagnosed condition to that failure; issue a superseding instruction for the same patient or explicitly entered related patient. Historical event truth, correctness of a recommendation and success of a later action are separate commitments.
design.unit: Two complete already-exposed prose contexts, including every exact group and alternative reading, nominated before new meanings. Exact context/source IDs and prospective meaning bindings are missing; producer reads no manuscript bodies.
design.contrast: Prior attempt remains recorded while its instruction is superseded versus negative wording erasing the earlier event, changing material identity, or a corrected instruction automatically entailing successful later execution.
design.prediction: One fixed correction/supersession construction must consume the reported failure, a written criterion or diagnosis and a replacement instruction in both whole contexts. The old episode must remain identifiable. If a later success is asserted it requires a separately paid event. Changing existing model values in response to criticism is not evidence for the manuscript containing a correction.
design.scope: Speculative narrative/technical correction role only; no adaptation of FM/FN, no trial-error decoder, no new audit framework and no implied source identity.

missing_inputs: Complete owned contexts with actual written failure/criterion/correction contributions
Paid reference to the old attempted event and the revised recommendation
Explicit patient identity or written re-entry; no hidden referent fallback
A complete cached historical correction passage verified before scientific selection
required_falsifier: Reject if the fixed account cannot retain the earlier attempt while withdrawing its recommendation, if diagnosis is invented from the desired correction, or if one negative/correction form needs inconsistent scopes across contexts.
exact_changed_research_decision: Adds a content-internal corrective episode rival to repeated processing; absent a paid failure/correction/participant chain, it remains an unselected raw idea.
